questions.question: ________ are you waiting for?
questions.explanation: 'What' is used to ask about things. 'What' ဖြင့် အရာဝတ္ထုကိုမေးပါ။

questions.question: ________ long is the movie?
questions.explanation: 'How long' is used to ask about duration. 'How long' ဖြင့် ကြာချိန်ကိုမေးပါ။

questions.question: ________ did you buy?
questions.explanation: 'What' is used to ask about things. 'What' ဖြင့် အရာဝတ္ထုကိုမေးပါ။

questions.question: ________ many students are there?
questions.explanation: 'How many' is used to ask about countable quantity. 'How many' ဖြင့် ရေတွက်နိုင်တဲ့ ပမာဏကိုမေးပါ။

questions.question: ________ is the weather today?
questions.explanation: 'How' is used to ask about condition. 'How' ဖြင့် အခြေအနေကိုမေးပါ။

questions.question: ________ do you work?
questions.explanation: 'Where' is used to ask about a place. 'Where' ဖြင့် နေရာကိုမေးပါ။

questions.question: ________ does the bus come?
questions.explanation: 'When' is used to ask about time. 'When' ဖြင့် အချိန်ကိုမေးပါ။

questions.question: ________ kind of music do you like?
questions.explanation: 'What kind' is used to ask about type or kind. 'What kind' ဖြင့် အမျိုးအစားကိုမေးပါ။

questions.question: ________ did you give it to?
questions.explanation: 'Who' is used to ask about people (object). 'Who' ဖြင့် လူတစ်ယောက်ကိုမေးပါ။
